_comment: Luckin Coffee historical Connecteam sampling recaps (Jul–Aug 2026). Parsed from eight PDF exports. Date + Store / Account Location become the event; Event Name is explicit per row so same-day multi-store shifts do not collide.
engagements_field: Number of people approached and engaged

rows.Store / Account Location: 128 W 32nd St, New York, NY 10001, USA
rows.Key customer feedback/issues: Mostly QR code angle issues, some couldn't download the app due to country restrictions.
rows.Customer profile: Commuters walking through to get to penn station, tourists exploring and office workers from above the location.

rows.Store / Account Location: 128 W 32nd St, New York, NY 10001, USA
rows.Key customer feedback/issues: People who either work or live nearby mostly interested. Was alot more x challenging to attract people vs Thursday.
rows.Customer profile: Mostly office workers from abovefloors, students and commuters.

rows.Event Name: Luckin Coffee — 128 W 32nd St — Aug 4 AM (#3)
rows.Store / Account Location: 128 W 32nd St, New York, NY 10001, USA
rows.Key customer feedback/issues: Some people downloaded but didn't want to make a purchase because colleagues did luckin hour. Did the activation during this and it did effect choice a lot.
rows.Customer profile: Office worker, students, locals walking their dog

rows.Walk-by traffic: The traffic was sparadic. Many onlookers was very interested. But there were times where the traffic was a bit dead
rows.Key customer feedback/issues: Tourist was interested but the app is not available if the phone comes from the UK. Many still went inside to purchase when. Original location had a water quality issue and had to pivot to another location where foot traffic wasn't as strong. Customers who either download the app earlier in the day and were coming back for a second drink was upset that they were giving the freebies so late. One customer in particular didn't want to put her phone number in the app for the discount.

rows.Walk-by traffic: Super Heavy. When it wasn't as heavy it still remained consistent
rows.Key customer feedback/issues: Of course many were upset if they recently purchased a drunk weather it was earlier that day or the well people truly wanted the merch. Customers mention how many times they come to the store on a daily and weekly basis and I felt so bad telling them it's only for new users. Tourist still purchased although they couldn't get the discount. One customer wanted to pay cash because they didn't have a card and couldn't complete her purchase.
rows.Customer profile: Workers from neighboring businesses, tourist, students, shoppers
